questions: Are you working or studying at the moment?
Why did you choose that job or subject?
What is the most difficult part of your work or studies?
Do you prefer to work or study in the morning or in the evening?
What did you do last weekend?
Do you usually plan your weekends in advance?
Are your weekends different now from when you were a child?
Do you think weekends should be longer?
Do you keep any plants at home?
Did you learn about plants when you were at school?
Is there a plant or flower that is special in your country?

part2.cue: Describe a book you have read that you found interesting.
points: when and why you read it
part2.final: and explain why you found this book interesting.
followups: Would you recommend this book to your friends?

questions: Why do some children enjoy reading while others do not?
What can parents do to encourage their children to read more?
Should schools let children choose the books they read in class?
Do you think printed books will disappear in the future?
What are the advantages of reading on a screen compared with reading on paper?
Some people say that watching a film of a story is as valuable as reading the book. Do you agree?
